## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      8 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 13, 2026 - Aug 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _how will he get a kiz kizz_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "i’ve used this app for 6 years now, and each year, this app gets worse everything is stuck behind a paywall now and is almost unusable. although it’s the most popular app, i’d much rather use any other, newer app, due to the sheer amount of paywalls this app has. this app used to be so much more streamlined and user-friendly but has gone down the drain in recent years"
            2. _Foody tracker_, Aug 15, 2026, 1/5: "Had this app for ages. Everything worked great then all off a sudden everything was behind a paywall and to scan my food I had to pay for the premium after using the app for years before."
            3. _Dil S C_, Aug 17, 2026, 2/5: "I’ve been using MFP since 2019 so 7 years or so now. Giving it 2 stars because it still gets the job done at the most basic level but holy moly, the new layout update is truly bad. The new layout gives you less information, less functionality, and requires more time to use. I’ve been using it for several weeks now figuring I just needed time to adjust to it like previous layout changes but this time it is unequivocally worse. I pay for a subscription to use the barcode scanner (another previously-free feature that became paywalled) so I can’t speak about the ads but given the trendline over the years of worse and worse design while pricing goes up I may need to start looking for an alternative app. A real shame."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      4 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Aug 15, 2026 - Aug 17, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kodefuguru_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "MyFitnessPal’s ads on AMC+ are substantially louder than the shows and every other commercial. It is extremely irritating to have to grab the remote and mute the television every time one comes on. Congratulations: your advertising was effective. It persuaded me to download the app—specifically so I could give it one star."
            2. _Zygy_zygyzyg_, Aug 17, 2026, 2/5: "Clunky ui, missing buttons and more ads"
            3. _FoDu1379_, Aug 16, 2026, 2/5: "I’ve had and used the app off and on for several years. Seems lately the goal for them to make more money has become their #1 priority. Almost $7 a month is a bit pricey for a user like myself, so I put up with the banner ads- no problem. But, with the last update…. now, after you log your first meal your greeted with a full screen ad or video where the close button, if available, is very difficult to find. I usually close the app and reopen it to get back to the app. This process is extremely annoying, and feels overblown. I’d look elsewhere if you’re new to a calorie/fitness app."
<!--/ir-theme-->

         **Review examples:**

            2. _how will he get a kiz kizz_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "i’ve used this app for 6 years now, and each year, this app gets worse everything is stuck behind a paywall now and is almost unusable. although it’s the most popular app, i’d much rather use any other, newer app, due to the sheer amount of paywalls this app has. this app used to be so much more streamlined and user-friendly but has gone down the drain in recent years"
            3. _Jen,seeking resolution_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible navigation, continually have Mondays entries end up on the following Sunday, no longer is there mass delete, various editing functions gone, way more clicks to add and delete, hideous UI and UX, glitchy. Did anyone bother to even do a feature gap analysis before deploying this junk that has had nothing but terrible reviews none of which have they remedied or even addressed? Boycot these people"
